adjudication.rationale: In db/migrate/20150818190757_create_embeddable_hosts.rb the migration loops over previous SiteSetting embeddable_hosts lines and runs `execute "INSERT INTO embeddable_hosts ... VALUES ('#{h}', ...)"`. This directly interpolates `h` into a single-quoted SQL string with no escaping/quoting helper. If any existing configured host contains a single quote (or other SQL-significant characters), the SQL becomes invalid and can abort the migration (and is also vulnerable to injection via the stored setting).
